milestone: Native CPU numeric arrays and tensors inside immutable records

contract.categories: Numeric arrays and ranked tensors, including rank zero and empty values, directly or inside finite nested records
contract.shapes: Strict source category/element identity; fixed dimension guards; fresh dynamic shape identities per field read
contract.ownership: Logical row-major copy when initializing/replacing or reading a collection field; recursive immutable backing retention through worker packets and observations
contract.cleanup: Record backing stays invocation-owned until settlement; scalar CLI entry releases tagged record owners after result computation; ordinary tensor owners remain under existing bufferization cleanup
contract.layout: Canonical inline descriptors; source ownership/range/stride/count validation before reading or retaining; no partial publication on retain failure
contract.limits: 128 tensor dimensions and existing finite-record depth/expanded layout budgets; collection descriptors count storage words
contract.ABI: Private compiler/runtime layouts only; no public C/C++ or distributed ABI

coverage: Raw numeric bits including float signed zero/NaN payloads and integer extremes
Nested records and multiple fields sharing the same allocation
Source packet overwrite and source invocation settlement immediately after submission
Repeated observations, cached outcomes, output canaries and failed observation buffers unchanged
Surviving observed storage after group release and scheduler destruction
Pre-dispatch cancellation/deadline, task budget rejection, task and invocation allocation failure
Static/dynamic/empty/rank-zero fields, immutable updates and TaskError recovery
Imported inferred record identity and executable documentation example
Descriptor forgery, lease survival, duplicate-owner release, partial-retain cleanup
Existing records, compiler, task/continuation, collection, allocation and selected Metal regressions
qualification.scope: Focused qualification, not the full test suite

optimization_followups: Earlier last-use reclamation of record field backing
Shared immutable collection storage/views to avoid pack/read copies
next_gate: Whole-record captures in anonymous numeric callbacks
boundaries: Native distributed execution requires design discussion
